binding_selection_criteria: an official FingerCell sample exists for it
it exposes or allows reading the settings
it supports runtime and module inspection sufficiently
it needs the least additional glue
components_to_look_for: the managed or JAR binding, where one is used
runtime data, configuration or model files

claims_to_prove: the FingerCell algorithm module is the extractor under test
the FingerCell algorithm module is the matcher under test
no VeriFinger extractor or matcher is reachable from the route
no prior algorithm's adapter, bridge or configuration is imported
no prior algorithm's scores are read
contamination.evidence: the transitive module closure of the FingerCell route is FingerCell plus the common runtime, the media runtime and the licensing runtime; the general biometrics module that carries the vendor's other fingerprint engine is not reachable from it. Recorded as a static candidate closure and confirmed against the loaded module set once the bridge runs
refused_components: a general biometric engine that dispatches to either of them
a VeriFinger template format used as the compared representation
a VeriFinger configuration or settings profile

delivered_observations.statement: the archive reports product revision number 20211013 and product revision hash 394e593011b1b1dca288371e0af499198f4a77d1
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: the exact product revision, and that it agrees with the public release notes rather than merely being assumed to

delivered_observations.statement: FingerCellMatch takes a FingerCell handle, a reference record handle and a candidate record handle, and writes the matching score through an NInt out-parameter
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: the raw 1:1 score route, its native signed-integer type, and the vendor's own names for the two sides of a comparison - which is where the frozen pair binding takes its words from

delivered_observations.statement: FingerCellExtract takes a FingerCell handle and an image handle and writes one record buffer through an out-parameter
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: that one image produces one template through one call, with no record container and no multi-finger structure in the route

delivered_observations.statement: the Match wrapper documents its return value as a matching score for which a bigger score means the fingerprints are more similar
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: the score direction, from the delivered binding rather than from a product page

delivered_observations.statement: the delivered template format enumeration is Proprietary=0, Iso=1, Moc=2, Unknown=3
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: that the proprietary format is the zero value, and that ISO and MOC are separate exports this stage refuses as the compared representation

delivered_observations.statement: the delivered C++ binding exposes exactly three typed properties - ImageQualityThreshold with a documented range of 0 to 100 and default 60, MatchingAlgorithm with a documented range of 0 to 100 and default 0, and TemplateFormat - and exposes them through a generic named property mechanism inherited from the common object base
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: three of the score-affecting settings and their documented defaults, and - more importantly - that the typed surface is narrower than the property surface, so a closure built from the header alone would be incomplete

delivered_observations.statement: the delivered API offers template merging across a bounded number of source records
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: that merging is a real and supported upstream scenario, and therefore that refusing it here is a deliberate protocol choice rather than an absence

delivered_observations.statement: the official verification tutorial obtains a licence for the component named FingerCell, constructs one FingerCell object, and prints the integer returned by Match on two record buffers, applying no threshold and making no decision
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: the official 1:1 route end to end, that the score is readable without any decision, and that the entitlement obtained is FingerCell's own rather than a general biometric one

delivered_observations.statement: the official extraction tutorial loads an image through the delivered image loader and passes it directly to Extract, with no cropping, resizing or enhancement of any kind between the file and the extractor
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: that the upstream route performs no preprocessing outside the SDK, so any that fpbench added would be fpbench's own

delivered_observations.statement: the archive ships FingerCell samples for C++ on the desktop and for Java on Android, and ships no desktop Java sample and no C# sample for FingerCell; the FingerCell tutorials are C++ only
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: the binding selection. The engineering preference was Java, conditional on a complete and suitable sample existing for it; the only delivered Java sample targets Android, which is a different platform and a different licensing route from the Windows and Linux x86-64 target this benchmark runs on (docs/adr/0116)

delivered_observations.statement: the archive ships a FingerCell native module and import library per platform, a FingerCell Java binding jar, and FingerCell assemblies for both .NET Framework and .NET Standard
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: that all three candidate bindings are genuinely shipped, so the selection is decided by the sample and tutorial coverage rather than by availability

delivered_observations.statement: the delivered licence agreement grants a personal, non-exclusive licence to use the SDK for the purpose of designing, developing, testing and distributing licensee products, and restricts reverse engineering, decompilation, disassembly, rental, removal of proprietary notices and transfer of rights; it states no restriction on publishing measurements obtained with the SDK
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: the terms Stage 8E is applied to. The grant covers local testing, and the absence of a publication restriction is recorded as an absence that was looked for rather than as a permission that was assumed

delivered_observations.statement: the delivered activation guide states that trial products allow a 30 day trial period, that a constant internet connection is required to use a trial product, and that the trial must be activated - by a wizard on Windows or manually - before use
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: that activation is a distinct, deliberate act rather than a side-effect of unpacking, which is what makes it possible to build and compile the qualification bridge before any clock starts (docs/adr/0115)

delivered_observations.statement: the archive ships a trial flag file, set to TRUE, which the delivered samples and tutorials read to decide whether to run in trial mode
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: that trial mode is selected by the delivered material itself, so the qualification bridge follows the same switch the official samples do rather than inventing a licensing path

delivered_observations.statement: the FingerCell module's import table names the common Neurotechnology runtime and the media runtime, together with platform C runtime and socket libraries, and does not name the general biometrics module that carries the vendor's other fingerprint engine
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: nothing on its own. It is the reason to ask the runtime which modules it actually loads, and the contamination claim is settled by that observation and by the delivered headers - not by this one (docs/adr/0120)

delivered_observations.statement: the module's embedded literals include property names the delivered C++ binding exposes no typed accessor for - among them the minutiae count limits, the large-template switch and a quality-use switch - together with messages about a minimum image resolution and about a selected matching algorithm being unavailable
delivered_observations.what_it_settles: nothing on its own, and it is the single most useful thing this stage has learned so far: the settings surface is wider than the typed API, so the closure gate must enumerate properties on a constructed engine through the supported property mechanism instead of ticking off a list written in advance (docs/adr/0118)

observed_identity.binding_selection_basis: the only delivered FingerCell desktop sample and the only FingerCell tutorials are C++; the Java binding ships but its only FingerCell sample targets Android, and the .NET assemblies ship with no FingerCell sample at all
